description: This file contains a collection of shell script functions related to managing pull requests, including checking paths for merge relevance, verifying merge conditions, and executing a merge process with detailed steps for conflict handling, approvals, and post-merge cleanup.

methods.name: is_mainline_drift_critical_path_for_merge
methods.description: Determines if a given file path is part of the mainline drift critical infrastructure, based on filename patterns.

methods.name: print_file_list_with_limit
methods.description: Prints a label, the line count of a file, and the first few lines up to a limit, indicating if there are more lines.

methods.name: mainline_drift_requires_sync
methods.description: Checks if the current branch is in sync with mainline, specifically detecting if critical infrastructure files are drifting, requiring sync.

methods.name: merge_verify
methods.description: Performs several validation steps to verify that a pull request can be merged, including checks on PR status, required checks, and syncing state.

methods.name: merge_run
methods.description: Automates the process of merging a pull request, including pre-merge validations, handling merge conflicts, and cleanup after merge.
